from solution import diff_consecutivenums


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: [1,1,3,4,4,5,6,7] gives [0,2,1,0,1,1,1]."""
    # 1-1=0, 3-1=2, 4-3=1, 4-4=0, 5-4=1, 6-5=1, 7-6=1
    assert diff_consecutivenums([1, 1, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6, 7]) == [0, 2, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1]


def test_issue_empty():
    """Empty list has no consecutive numbers so result is []."""
    # no pairs -> []
    assert diff_consecutivenums([]) == []


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Single element has no consecutive pair so result is []."""
    # no pairs from [42] -> []
    assert diff_consecutivenums([42]) == []


def test_issue_two_increasing():
    """Difference between two consecutive numbers [1,5] is [4]."""
    # 5-1=4
    assert diff_consecutivenums([1, 5]) == [4]


def test_issue_two_decreasing_signed():
    """Difference keeps sign so [5,1] gives [-4]."""
    # 1-5=-4
    assert diff_consecutivenums([5, 1]) == [-4]


def test_issue_all_equal():
    """Equal consecutive numbers differ by zero."""
    # 7-7=0, 7-7=0
    assert diff_consecutivenums([7, 7, 7]) == [0, 0]


def test_issue_mixed_sign():
    """Difference between consecutive numbers works across zero."""
    # 3-(-2)=5, -1-3=-4
    assert diff_consecutivenums([-2, 3, -1]) == [5, -4]


def test_issue_strictly_decreasing():
    """Decreasing consecutive numbers give negative differences."""
    # 8-10=-2, 6-8=-2, 4-6=-2
    assert diff_consecutivenums([10, 8, 6, 4]) == [-2, -2, -2]


def test_contract_result_is_list():
    """Function returns a list of consecutive differences."""
    # 2-1=1, 3-2=1 -> [1, 1]
    result = diff_consecutivenums([1, 2, 3])
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_contract_length_is_n_minus_one():
    """Output has one fewer item than input list."""
    # 6-4=2, 9-6=3, 13-9=4 -> 3 diffs from 4 inputs
    result = diff_consecutivenums([4, 6, 9, 13])
    assert len(result) == 3
